blurb: An embed is a `String` constant used by its name, so a unit declares each name once: a second `embed shell` would leave `shell` meaning two files. Give each embed its own name. An embed whose name is an asset's, a function's or a type's is `bynk.resolve.name_conflict` instead.
example:
embed shell = "embeds/page.html"
embed shell = "embeds/other.html"     // ✗ `shell` is already declared

embed shell = "embeds/page.html"
embed footer = "embeds/other.html"    // ✓ one name each
summary: An `embed` name is declared more than once in the same unit.
